name: Hayabusa
description: Generate forensic timelines from Windows event logs and hunt with Sigma detection rules.
about: Windows event logs hold the record of what happened on a machine, spread across dozens of channels in a format nobody reads directly. Hayabusa walks a folder of .evtx files and produces a single timeline, applying thousands of bundled Sigma detection rules as it goes so suspicious activity is flagged with a severity rather than left to be spotted by eye. It is normally the first thing pointed at a compromised host, because it turns hours of log triage into one sorted file.
